partners.diseaseBName: mitochondrial myopathy, episodic, with optic atrophy and reversible leukoencephalopathy
partners.mechanism_chain: ISCU (HGNC:28713) —DISRUPTS→ Mitochondrial iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis (GO:0000051); Mitochondrial iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis (GO:0000051) —DECREASES→ Mitochondrial electron transport chain complex assembly (GO:0000122); Mitochondrial electron transport chain complex assembly (GO:0000122) —LEADS_TO→ Lactic acidosis (HP:0002139); Mitochondrial electron transport chain complex assembly (GO:0000122) —LEADS_TO→ Myopathy (HP:0003198); FDX2 (HGNC:3605) —DISRUPTS→ Mitochondrial iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis (GO:0000051); Mitochondrial electron transport chain complex assembly (GO:0000122) —LEADS_TO→ Optic atrophy (HP:0000648); Mitochondrial electron transport chain complex assembly (GO:0000122) —LEADS_TO→ Leukoencephalopathy (HP:0012447). Loss-of-function mutations in ISCU (disease A) and FDX2 (disease B) both impair mitochondrial iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis. This, in turn, compromises the assembly and function of mitochondrial electron transport chain complexes, leading to shared downstream phenotypes such as myopathy and lactic acidosis (disease A), and optic atrophy and leukoencephalopathy (disease B) due to cellular energy deficits and oxidative stress.

falsification.text: Identification of pathogenic variants in ISCU and FDX2 that do not impair mitochondrial iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis or electron transport chain complex assembly, or demonstration that the disease phenotypes arise from entirely independent molecular pathways not converging on mitochondrial function.
